description_en: Modifies the name and description of an endpoint group
description_zh: 调用UpdateEndpointGroupAttribute接口修改终端节点组的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-endpoint-group-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1ple63864a5hyj50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEndpointGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅支持取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the endpoint group that you want to modify.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的终端节点组的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the endpoint group that you want to modify. The description can be up to 200 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的终端节点组的描述。
描述长度最大200字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
